title: Nine Feet Above the Fire
subtitle: 火灾安全 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 火灾安全（安全与救护·火灾安全）
meta: 主题语境：火灾安全（安全与救护·火灾安全）　|　核心词汇：ceiling　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ceiling 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my mother was sent to paint ① ceiling she could not reach, and she said the painting was the whole of the lesson. The ② ceiling, meaning the surface and not the room, was nine feet high and was painted by whoever came last; ceiling, she said, is the only thing in a fire that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ ceiling in that house had the same crack, and the ④ ceiling at the end, meaning the one the inspector kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever painted properly. Ceiling, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ ceiling was the whole of the rule, meaning the limit it set and not the surface. The ⑥ ceiling, meaning the limit and not any of that, is the only thing in a rule that everybody accepts and nobody questions; ceiling, he said, is either something you paint or the only word that means both a surface and a limit. She said the limit is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ ceiling had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the crack. The ⑧ ceiling of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine feet and eleven years of painting; ceiling, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ ceiling I remember is the one at the end, which was painted in 1976 and is still described as the safest in the county. A ⑩ ceiling, my grandmother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being painted; every ceiling, she said, is a limit that has agreed to look like a surface. She said the limit was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 天花板（指那层表面本身，与整个房间相对）
C. 固定搭配：paint a ceiling 粉刷天花板
D. n. 天花板（指房子里每一处）
E. n. 天花板（指末尾那一处）
F. n. 上限（抽象：它设定的那条限度）
G. n. 那条限度（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The ceiling, meaning the surface and not the room
ceiling was the whole of the rule
the ceiling had become a number in a report
The ceiling of the whole thing
A ceiling, my grandmother said in 1981

answers.why: paint a ceiling 意为“粉刷天花板”，1958 年母亲被派去粉刷她够不到的那面天花板。
ceiling 意为“天花板、顶棚”，指那层表面本身而不是整个房间，高九英尺，由最后来的人粉刷。
ceiling 指房子里每一处天花板，每一处都有同样的裂缝。
ceiling 指末尾那一处（检查员保留的那一处），是唯一有人认真粉刷过的。
ceiling 意为“上限”，抽象指它设定的那条限度，父亲说 ceiling 就是那条规定的全部。
ceiling 为抽象用法，指那条限度本身，是一条规定里人人都接受、却没人质疑的东西。
ceiling 意为“天花板、顶棚”，到 1971 年这处 ceiling 成了报告里的一个数字。
ceiling 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺和十一年的粉刷。
ceiling 意为“天花板”，我记得的是末尾那一处，1976 年粉刷过，至今仍被说成全县最安全的。
ceiling 为抽象总称，祖母说一处天花板是唯一会因为被认真粉刷而变好的东西。
